name: ynab-mcp-remote
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a ynab-mcp server running in HTTP mode elsewhere, such as another machine on your network.
long_description: A small bridge that relays Claude Desktop's MCP traffic to a ynab-mcp server started with MCP_TRANSPORT=http and MCP_API_KEYS. The YNAB access token stays on the server; this machine only holds a revocable client key. Runs on Claude Desktop's built-in Node.js, so nothing else needs to be installed.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The ynab-mcp server endpoint, for example http://192.168.1.20:3000/mcp

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: This machine's key from the server's MCP_API_KEYS (the part after "name:")
